verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents issue exports to GitHub, GitLab, and Jira Cloud/Server with detailed markdown or wiki content, so an error can be pushed to a tracker as a ticket. Nothing in the evidence shows two-way status sync, closing a ticket resolving the error, a regression reopening the ticket, or any Linear integration. Missing for 10: two-way status sync between ticket and error, ticket-close-resolves-error behavior, regression-reopens-ticket behavior, Linear support, independent corroboration.
